pitchEn: Design and arrange your dream home floor by floor: choose the footprint, roof style, number of floors, wall and accent colors, add rooms and upload photos, then browse a gallery of other people’s homes and climb a community ranking of the most-liked designs.
newFeaturesEn: v1.0020: Local mode — projects are stored on the device, no account and no connection needed; new My projects section; draft restored on next start; furniture photos and shape-from-photo processed on the phone; three example projects at first start; language picker (15 languages); backup server address. Account is optional — only for the gallery.

dataHandling.notes: The designer works fully on the device (local mode, no account, no connection). Only if the user chooses to register and publish a project to the shared gallery, the account details (e-mail, display name) and the published design leave the device to the server houselook.pupikes.com (backup address pupikes.app). A subscription for premium features is handled through the store billing.

reviewerRemarksEn: The app is embedded and works offline: the home designer, My projects, furniture photos and shape-from-photo all run on the device without an account (three example projects are included at first start). An account is optional and only needed to publish to the shared gallery, like and see the ranking (server houselook.pupikes.com with a backup address). If the server is unreachable the app keeps working locally and explains it — no raw network errors.
